Job Description Summary
As a Software Engineering Intern at GE Healthcare for our MIM Commercialized Web Applications team, you will contribute to our web applications sold to customers – MIMcloud and MIM Anyware.

MIMcloud is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) web application which enables secure, HIPAA-compliant cloud-based storage and exchange of medical images between clinical facilities.

MIM Anyware is an on-premise web application which virtualizes access to our main desktop medical imaging application (MIM) through a web browser.
